what: Live Dream run on the left arm with Saleh's 17:00 hand-to-hand prompt went wrong and was stopped with the E-stop; dream_arm.py now ends the whole run when an arm does not verify its return home.
why: Dream's plan did not head for a grasp: over 13 cycles it swung the shoulder pan to about +74 deg and raised the arm (shoulder -128, elbow 155, wrist roll 64 SDK deg) with jaws open. pickup_server tripped on a motor 1 torque residual (2.33 Nm, likely contact), the operator pressed the E-stop, so rest could not return the arm (feedback timeout); the loop then tried to switch to the right arm.
details: Arm switching now happens only after a verified return home; an unverified return (fault, trip, E-stop, lost bus) stops the run.

Not ready for unattended or demo use on the real arms: Dream warns the tool centre point is uncalibrated and no person has checked its camera inputs (dream.check / dream.input_check). The team's working Dream handover remains the Unreal Table 10 path.
Left arm unpowered after the E-stop; inspect it before powering on.
